name: verify
notes: desos-verify checks the running system against the signed repository manifest and build evidence already shipped under /usr/share/desos/repository and /usr/share/doc/desos/build. Results: /run/desos/verify.json, /run/desos/verify-status (one line for the greeter/desktop), /var/lib/desos/verify-full.json. Schema desos-verify-v1 is documented in verify/README.md. These files are copied onto the image outside any signed package, so the verifier itself is not covered by the manifest it checks; see README.
